template_meta.title: Simple Service/Resource Booking
template_meta.description: The most basic setup for booking a single type of item, like a meeting room, a rental item, or a specific service. Recommended for new users.

clisyc_service.post_content: This is an example service. You can edit this or create new ones under the 'Services' menu in the Client Sync dashboard.
